produce_variation: produce text variations from a population of sentences using RoBERTa masked language model with configurable masking percentage
collate_fn_tokenizer: collate tokenized inputs and randomly mask a percentage of tokens while preserving special tokens for batch processing
sample: sample replacement tokens for masked positions using top-k and top-p filtering with temperature-scaled logits from RoBERTa
run_variation: run the Variation module to generate varied text outputs from a population using RoBERTa-large with 8-bit loading
review_Variation_class: review the Variation class that uses RoBERTa masked language modeling to produce text variations with configurable masking and sampling parameters
